newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei ends down but off lows.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei ends down but off lows.

text.p: Simex Nikkei futures ended easier but off the day's lows on Thursday.
Dealers said selling in the session was a follow-through from Wednesday's gloomy Tankan corporate report by the Bank of Japan.
"The Nikkei is testing support at the 20,500 level. Sentiment is a bit gloomy because people are focusing on the weak recovery in the economy at the moment," said a dealer with a European bank.
September Nikkei settled at 20,605 after touching an intraday low of 20,530 against its previous close of 20,725. Volume was 19,560 contracts.
Dealers said technically, the index should see good support at 20,300 and the upside should be capped at 21,000.
